-- coding.helper.enforce_quota
-- Protocol-7 module for enforcing per-job byte quotas

local M = {}

M.name = "coding.helper.enforce_quota"
M.description = "Enforces per-job byte quotas from config"

local QUOTA_DEFAULT = 4096

-- Track usage per job ID
local job_usage = {}

-- Read quota from config, default to 4096 if not set
local function get_quota()
    local quota = config.get("coding.helper.enforce_quota", "quota")
    if not quota or quota == "" then
        return QUOTA_DEFAULT
    end
    return tonumber(quota) or QUOTA_DEFAULT
end

-- Track bytes used by a job
local function track_usage(job_id, bytes)
    job_usage[job_id] = (job_usage[job_id] or 0) + bytes
end

-- Check if a job has exceeded its quota
-- Returns: true if within quota, false if exceeded
local function check_quota(job_id, bytes)
    local quota = get_quota()
    local current = job_usage[job_id] or 0
    local new_total = current + bytes

    if new_total > quota then
        log.warning(
            "Job '" .. job_id .. "' exceeds byte quota: " ..
            new_total .. " / " .. quota ..
            " (quota: " .. quota .. " bytes)"
        )
        return false
    end

    track_usage(job_id, bytes)
    return true
end

-- Module registration point
function M.register()
    M.init = function()
        -- Ensure we have a valid quota
        local quota = get_quota()
        log.info(
            "coding.helper.enforce_quota initialized with quota: " .. quota .. " bytes"
        )
    end

    M.check = check_quota
    return M.name
end

return M
